say:0:1120000101:0.text: This tomb is massive... I'm starting to feel dizzy from all the twists and turns!
say:0:1120000101:0.source_cn: 这个地下墓穴实在太庞大了……我已经绕晕了！

say:1:1120000102:0.text: Don't worry, the Magister's been mapping our path. We won't get lost.
